dimensions.name: CAMPAIGN_EXECUTION_COMPLETENESS
dimensions.numerator_definition: Unique selected memberships with actual attempt and verifiable terminal disposition
dimensions.denominator_definition: All selected memberships in each family/version/split/locale
dimensions.rule: Exact ID set equality; attempts>0 for every member; no inflight/ambiguous receipts; all six families

dimensions.name: PGOP1_AUDIT_COVERAGE
dimensions.numerator_definition: Unique unit-predicate pairs with performed audit and evidence-backed decision, stratified structural/provenance/semantic
dimensions.denominator_definition: All semantically applicable selected unit-predicate pairs from the complete eight-predicate candidate universe, including unavailable evidence and UNKNOWN_APPLICABILITY; planned allocation cannot prune this denominator
dimensions.rule: Abstentions/errors do not count as completed evidence-backed semantic verdicts; report audit attempts separately

dimensions.name: EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY
dimensions.numerator_definition: Unit-predicate pairs meeting frozen evidence prerequisites
dimensions.denominator_definition: All semantically applicable selected unit-predicate pairs from the complete eight-predicate candidate universe, including unavailable evidence and UNKNOWN_APPLICABILITY; planned allocation cannot prune this denominator
dimensions.rule: Authentic output necessary for agent semantic predicates, not sufficient; report missing/ambiguous inputs

dimensions.name: OFFICIAL_EVALUATOR_COVERAGE
dimensions.numerator_definition: Units with actual valid official evaluator result in named submode
dimensions.denominator_definition: Both full selected population mapping and frozen planned/eligible submode population, reported separately
dimensions.rule: B complementary; never mix calls/trajectories/tasks or static inspection/fresh execution

dimensions.name: ENGINEERING_QUALITY
dimensions.numerator_definition: Validated requirements or reproduced defects fixed with matched regression evidence, separately
dimensions.denominator_definition: Frozen technical requirement set or reproduced defect set, respectively
dimensions.rule: Do not invent zero defects; open/nonreproduced/unknown defects visible; no model-performance proxy

dimensions.name: INDEPENDENT_SEMANTIC_QUALIFICATION
dimensions.numerator_definition: Qualified independent true positives etc. only under separate procedure
dimensions.rule: NOT_ACHIEVED; precision/recall NOT_COMPUTABLE; no qualified denominator here

execution_complete_iff: All six exact frozen selected ID sets reconciled
Every selected membership has an actual processing attempt and verifiable terminal receipt
No duplicate inflation, missing or inflight dispositions
Receipt/checkpoint integrity and recovery verification passed

applicability_policy.universe: All selected unit memberships × eight predicate families from the execution plan; retained exact pair ledger
applicability_policy.unknown_policy: Included conservatively in applicable denominator; separately disclosed
applicability_policy.not_applicable_requires: Versioned semantic domain exclusion, evidence and rationale; never evidence/runtime/output/reference/reserve unavailability
applicability_policy.reconciliation: Universe = applicable including unknown + genuine not_applicable; exact sets/counts; all applicable pairs remain in audit denominator
applicability_policy.reporting: Separate structural/provenance/semantic coverage and per-predicate NA/missing/unknown counts
